verses.en: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.pt: Sucedeu depois disso que Davi derrotou os filisteus, e os sujeitou; e Davi tomou a Metegue-Ama das mãos dos filisteus.
verses.en_web: After this, David struck the Philistines and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about after this that David made an attack on the Philistines and overcame them; and David took the authority of the mother-town from the hands of the Philistines.

verses.en: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.
verses.pt: Também derrotou os moabitas, e os mediu com cordel, fazendo-os deitar por terra; e mediu dois cordéis para os matar, e um cordel inteiro para os deixar com vida. Ficaram assim os moabitas por servos de Davi, pagando-lhe tributos.
verses.en_web: He struck Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
verses.en_bbe: And he overcame the Moabites, and he had them measured with a line when they were stretched out on the earth; marking out two lines for death and one full line for life. So the Moabites became servants to David and gave him offerings.

verses.en: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
verses.pt: Davi também derrotou a Hadadézer, filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá, quando este ia estabelecer o seu domínio sobre o rio Eufrates.
verses.en_web: David struck also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
verses.en_bbe: And David overcame Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to make his power seen by the River.

verses.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
verses.pt: E tomou-lhe Davi mil e setecentos cavaleiros e vinte mil homens de infantaria; e Davi jarretou a todos os cavalos dos carros, reservando apenas cavalos para cem carros.
verses.en_web: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen. David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for one hundred chariots.
verses.en_bbe: And David took from him one thousand, seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen: and David had the leg-muscles of the horses cut, only keeping enough of them for a hundred war-carriages.

verses.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.pt: Os sírios de Damasco vieram socorrer a Hadadézer, rei de Zobá, mas Davi matou deles vinte e dois mil homens.
verses.en_web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty two thousand men of the Syrians.
verses.en_bbe: And when the Aramaeans of Damascus came to the help of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, David put to the sword twenty-two thousand of the Aramaeans.

verses.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.pt: Então Davi pôs guarnições em Síria de Damasco, e os sírios ficaram por servos de Davi, pagando-lhe tributos. E o Senhor lhe dava a vitória por onde quer que ia.
verses.en_web: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.en_bbe: And David put armed forces in Aram of Damascus: and the Aramaeans became servants to David and gave him offerings. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

verses.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: E Davi tomou os escudos de ouro que os servos de Hadadézer usavam, e os trouxe para Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And David took their gold body-covers from the servants of Hadadezer and took them to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
verses.pt: De Betá e de Berotai, cidades de Hadadézer, o rei Davi tomou grande quantidade de bronze.
verses.en_web: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took a great quantity of brass.
verses.en_bbe: And from Tebah and Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a great store of brass.

verses.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
verses.pt: Quando Toí, rei de Hamate, ouviu que Davi ferira todo o exército de Hadadézer,
verses.en_web: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,
verses.en_bbe: And when Tou, king of Hamath, had news that David had overcome all the army of Hadadezer,

verses.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.pt: mandou-lhe seu filho Jorão para saudá-lo, e para felicitá-lo por haver pelejado contra Hadadézer e o haver derrotado; pois Hadadézer de contínuo fazia guerra a Toí. E Jorão trouxe consigo vasos de prata de ouro e de bronze,
verses.en_web: then Toi sent Joram his son to king David, to greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.en_bbe: He sent his son Hadoram to David, with words of peace and blessing, because he had overcome Hadadezer in the fight, for Hadadezer had wars with Tou; and Hadoram took with him vessels of silver and gold and brass:

verses.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the LORD, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
verses.pt: os quais o rei Davi consagrou ao Senhor, como já havia consagrado a prata e o ouro de todas as nações que sujeitara.
verses.en_web: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued;
verses.en_bbe: These King David made holy to the Lord, together with the silver and gold which he had taken from the nations he had overcome--

verses.en: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.pt: da Síria, de Moabe, dos amonitas, dos filisteus, de Amaleque e dos despojos de Hadadézer, filho de Reobe, rei de Zobá.
verses.en_web: of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.en_bbe: The nations of Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon and the Philistines and the Amalekites and the goods he had taken from Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

verses.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
verses.pt: Assim Davi ganhou nome para si. E quando voltou, matou no Vale do Sal a dezoito mil edomitas.
verses.en_web: David earned a reputation when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand men of the Syrians in the Valley of Salt.
verses.en_bbe: And David got great honour for himself, when he came back, by the destruction of Edom in the valley of Salt, to the number of eighteen thousand men.

verses.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David’s servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.pt: E pôs guarnições em Edom; pô-las em todo o Edom, e todos os edomitas tornaram-se servos de Davi. E o Senhor lhe dava a vitória por onde quer que ia.
verses.en_web: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.en_bbe: And he put armed forces in Edom; all through Edom he had armed forces stationed, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.

verses.en: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
verses.pt: Reinou, pois, Davi sobre todo o Israel, e administrava a justiça e a eqüidade a todo o seu povo.
verses.en_web: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.en_bbe: And David was king over all Israel, judging and giving right decisions for all his people.

verses.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.pt: Joabe, filho de Zeruia, estava sobre o exército; Jeosafá, filho de Ailude, era cronista;
verses.en_web: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
verses.en_bbe: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the army; and Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was keeper of the records;

verses.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
verses.pt: Zadoque, filho de Aitube, e Aimeleque, filho de Abiatar, eram sacerdotes; Seraías era escrivão;
verses.en_web: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar were priests, Seraiah was scribe,
verses.en_bbe: And Zadok and Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, were priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief rulers.
verses.pt: Benaías, filho de Jeoiada, tinha o cargo dos quereteus e peleteus; e os filhos de Davi eram ministros de estado.
verses.en_web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, David’s sons were chief ministers.
verses.en_bbe: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were priests.
